title: cephalophyllum tricolorum
intro: Cephalophyllum tricolorum, commonly known as the "three-coloured cliff bush" or "Cape cliff bush", is a species of succulent plant in the family Aizoaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
